general.notes: Copper 10GBASE-T SFP+ electrical module over twisted pair (Cat 6A/7 UTP for up to 30 m at 10G; Cat 5e for 100/1000M). Table 5 reach condition: BER <10^-12. Clock tolerance +/-50 ppm. Default full-duplex preferred master mode. 16-level PAM on 10G link per Description. Supply current 500–750 mA at 3.3 V (Table 1). Line frequency 800 MHz (Table 3). I2C at A0h; PHY access at ACh.
general.suggestions: Schema is optical-centric; consider copper-specific fields (cable category, max reach per rate, electrical line rate MHz, BER). form_factor enum lacks SFP+; connector_type enum lacks RJ45. bit_rate_gbps from ordering uses mixed units (10M/100M vs G); clarify whether 0.01/0.1 Gbps is desired vs literal strings.
